5. Amy kills the last zombie and the house is soaked in blood.
6. Amy lets Will and Amber out of the basement.

CANDIDATE BOUNDARY:
After unit 1.

Normal setup, inciting danger, protection/preparation, and the source-emphasized main process should remain one continuous chapter unless there is a major reset.
